sections.title: Key Debuts and Free Content
items: Mega Mewtwo X and Mega Mewtwo Y debut in Super Mega Raids. Mewtwo caught from these raids unlocks at least Mega Level 1 and can Mega Evolve into the defeated form without the initial Mega Energy cost; completing raids also awards Mega Energy.
The global event is free for all Trainers; log in to access habitats, bonuses, Special Research, and increased Shiny opportunities.
Zeraora makes its global debut through Special Research. Each Trainer can receive at most one Zeraora encounter; duplicate GO Fest Special Research awards Zeraora Candy instead.
Bulbasaur, Charmander, and Squirtle wearing Pikachu sun visors appear and can evolve for the first time; Pikachu wearing team-themed hats also appears.

sections.title: Saturday Habitats and Raids
items: 10:00–13:00 “Stormfire Peaks” (Ice/Electric/Fire): Mega Ampharos, Mega Blaziken, and Mega Abomasnow in Mega Raids; Articuno, Zapdos, Moltres, Raikou, Entei, Suicune, Lugia, and Ho-Oh in 5★ raids.

13:00–16:00 “Stellar Tides” (Psychic/Ghost/Water): Mega Alakazam, Mega Gengar, and Mega Swampert in Mega Raids; Uxie, Mesprit, Azelf, Dialga, Palkia, Altered Forme Giratina, Origin Forme Giratina, Xerneas, Yveltal, Solgaleo, and Lunala in 5★ raids.
16:00–19:00 “Dragonflight Peaks” (Flying/Rock/Dragon): Mega Pidgeot, Mega Aerodactyl, and Mega Salamence in Mega Raids; Kyogre, Groudon, Rayquaza, Reshiram, Zekrom, and Kyurem in 5★ raids.
Saturday Super Mega Raids: Mega Mewtwo X.

sections.title: Sunday Habitats and Raids
items: 10:00–13:00 “Forged Grounds” (Ground/Steel/Normal): Mega Metagross, Mega Garchomp, and Mega Audino in Mega Raids; the Regi trio, Origin Forme Dialga, Origin Forme Palkia, Heatran, Regigigas, both Formes of Tornadus/Thundurus/Landorus, both Formes of Enamorus, Regieleki, and Regidrago in 5★ raids.

13:00–16:00 “Verdant Anomaly” (Bug/Grass/Poison): Mega Beedrill, Mega Pinsir, and Mega Sceptile in Mega Raids; all four Formes of Deoxys, Genesect with multiple Drives, Nihilego, Buzzwole, Pheromosa, Xurkitree, Celesteela, Kartana, Guzzlord, Necrozma, Stakataka, Blacephalon, and the Tapu family in 5★ raids.

16:00–19:00 “Twilight Battlefield” (Dark/Fairy/Fighting): Mega Tyranitar, Mega Gardevoir, and Mega Lucario in Mega Raids; Latias, Latios, Cresselia, Darkrai, Cobalion, Terrakion, Virizion, Zacian (Hero of Many Battles), and Zamazenta (Hero of Many Battles) in 5★ raids.

pokemon-horizons-the-series-celebration-.summary: The Pokémon Horizons: The Series Celebration Event returns September 16–22. Charmander wearing Friede's goggles and its Evolutions debut and can be found in the wild, through Field Research, from regular Lure Modules, and via the GO Pass.
bonuses: :pokestop: Increased chance to encounter Kecleon at PokéStops
:candy: From GO Pass Level 1: 2× Catch Candy; 3× with Deluxe
:lure: From GO Pass Level 10: regular Lure Modules last one hour and may attract protagonist Pokémon
:stardust: From GO Pass Level 20: extra Stardust for catching Hatenna and Wattrel

sections.title: Wild encounters and raids
items: Throughout the event, Charmander wearing Friede's goggles appears in the wild; Captain's Cap Pikachu may appear if you're lucky.
5:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.: Fidough and Wattrel; Chansey may appear if you're lucky. 5:00 p.m.–5:00 a.m. the next day: Eevee and Hatenna; Rockruff may appear if you're lucky.
1-star raids: Captain's Cap Pikachu; 3-star raids: Charizard wearing Friede's goggles, Meowscarada, Skeledirge, and Quaquaval.

sections.title: Event content
items: Event-themed Field Research, snapshot surprise encounters, and PokéStop Showcases with a changing category each day are available.
The free GO Pass is granted automatically; Deluxe costs US$4.99, and Deluxe + 6 Ranks costs US$6.99.
Claim GO Pass rewards by 8:00 p.m. on September 24.

pokemon-go-wild-area-2026-sendai-japan.name: Pokémon GO Wild Area 2026: Sendai and Tohoku, Japan (in person)
pokemon-go-wild-area-2026-sendai-japan.heading: Wild Area
pokemon-go-wild-area-2026-sendai-japan.summary: The 2026 in-person Wild Area event takes place across Sendai and the Tohoku region from November 6 to 8. Dates and daily hours are confirmed; full gameplay details will be announced later.

pokemon-go-wild-area-2026-mexico-city.name: Pokémon GO Wild Area 2026: Mexico City (in person)
pokemon-go-wild-area-2026-mexico-city.heading: Wild Area
pokemon-go-wild-area-2026-mexico-city.summary: The 2026 in-person Wild Area event takes place in Mexico City from November 6 to 8. Dates and daily hours are confirmed; full gameplay details will be announced later.

pokemon-go-wild-area-2026-global.name: Pokémon GO Wild Area 2026: Global
pokemon-go-wild-area-2026-global.heading: Wild Area
pokemon-go-wild-area-2026-global.summary: The global Wild Area event runs November 14 and 15 from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. local time each day. Ticket and gameplay details will be announced later.

patterns-of-the-wild-2026.name: Patterns of the Wild (Indonesia only)
patterns-of-the-wild-2026.heading: Event
patterns-of-the-wild-2026.summary: Indonesia only: Pikachu wearing a batik shirt appears in the wild, Timed Research, and surprise snapshots, with a chance of a Special Background. Featured wild Pokémon have boosted Shiny odds.
bonuses: :incense: Incense lasts two hours
:incense: Incense is more likely to attract Pikachu wearing a batik shirt and other featured Pokémon
✨ Increased chance of encountering featured Shiny wild Pokémon

sections.title: Timed Research
items: Timed Research is available from September 28 at 6:00 a.m. through October 7 at 11:59 p.m.
Rewards include Pikachu wearing a batik shirt with a Special Background, Oddish, Ledyba, Hoppip, 1,000 XP, and 1,000 Stardust; all encounters can be Shiny

sections.title: Snapshots and Collection Challenge
items: Take a snapshot of a Pokémon you own during the event for a surprise Pikachu wearing a batik shirt encounter
Complete the themed Collection Challenge for XP, Stardust, and Pikachu wearing a batik shirt stickers

harvest-festival-taken-over-2026.name: Harvest Festival: Taken Over
harvest-festival-taken-over-2026.heading: Event
harvest-festival-taken-over-2026.summary: Team GO Rocket takes over Harvest Festival. Earn a Super Rocket Radar from the event GO Pass, challenge Giovanni, and rescue Shadow Zekrom, with new Shadow lineups and the debut of Shiny Shroodle from Eggs.
bonuses: ✨ Increased chance of encountering Shiny Slugma
:rocket: Team GO Rocket appears more often at PokéStops and in balloons
Use a Charged TM to make Shadow Pokémon forget Frustration
Pokémon caught from one- and three-star Shadow Raids have a wider Attack, Defense, and HP IV range

sections.title: Giovanni and GO Pass
items: Earn a Super Rocket Radar through the Harvest Festival GO Pass; Giovanni appears only at PokéStops and lets you rescue Shadow Zekrom
Claim GO Pass rewards by October 7 at 8:00 p.m.; Shadow and Purified Pokémon cannot fuse

sections.title: Debuts
items: Shadow Wimpod, Shadow Fomantis, and Shadow Sandygast join Team GO Rocket lineups
Shiny Shroodle debuts from 12 km Eggs and can evolve into Shiny Grafaiai

sections.title: Field Research
sections.body: Event-themed Field Research awards Fast TMs, Charged TMs, and Mysterious Components; tasks and quantities have not yet been announced.

gigantamax-cinderace-max-battle-day-2026.name: Gigantamax Cinderace Max Battle Day
gigantamax-cinderace-max-battle-day-2026.heading: Max Battles
gigantamax-cinderace-max-battle-day-2026.summary: Six-star Max Battles at every Power Spot feature Gigantamax Cinderace, with its Shiny debut. The event also increases Max Particle collection, Power Spot activity, and Special Trades.
bonuses: Max Particle collection limit increased to 1,600
:spawn: All Power Spots feature Gigantamax Cinderace, with more Power Spots and faster refreshes
8× Max Particles from Power Spots
:trading: Up to three Special Trades for the day
:raid: During the stated PDT window, the daily Remote Raid limit increases from 10 to 20

sections.title: All-day exploration bonuses
items: On October 3 from midnight to 5:00 p.m., earn 2× Max Particles from exploring
On October 3 from midnight to 5:00 p.m., adventuring distance to receive Max Particles is quartered

sections.title: Paid Timed Research
sections.body: The US$4.99 ticket awards one Max Mushroom, 25,000 XP, and 6,400 Max Particles, plus 2× XP from Max Battles during the event.

sections.title: Battle preparation
sections.body: Gigantamax Cinderace is a pure Fire type and is weak to Water, Ground, and Rock. Prepare eligible Dynamax or Gigantamax attackers and coordinate roles with your group.

choose-your-path-twilight-trails-2026.name: Choose Your Path: Twilight Trails
choose-your-path-twilight-trails-2026.heading: Choose Your Path
choose-your-path-twilight-trails-2026.summary: Timed Research is available from September 23 at 10:00 a.m. through September 28 at 8:00 p.m. local time. Choose the Explore, Catch, or Battle path; your choice determines the week’s tasks, rewards, and bonuses.
bonuses: Choose one of three paths: Explore, Catch, or Battle
Tasks, rewards, and bonuses depend on the selected path; details are pending

sections.title: Timed Research
items: Different Trainers may receive different versions of the research.
Complete the tasks and claim all rewards before September 28 at 8:00 p.m. local time.

rotations.note: September 5-star, Mega, and Max rotations are published through October 6; special Mega Ascension and GO Fest Mega Finale daily pools are retained.

Charmander wearing Friede's goggles Spotlight Hour offers 2× catch Stardust. Pair it with a Star Piece if Stardust is your priority.
